en.title: Version 1.1.0
en.content:
**Navigation**
- Replace icon-only header links with visible text across the application and public landing page, including Discord, GitHub, project support and sign-in/sign-out controls.
- Add an explicit dashboard link, preserve the current-page highlight and keep private and admin navigation restricted to the appropriate users.
- Introduce a collapsible menu on screens up to 1024 pixels wide, with keyboard support, Escape-to-close, responsive resizing and visible navigation when JavaScript is unavailable.

**Accessibility and translations**
- Preserve keyboard focus in the visible navigation when resizing from the mobile menu to the desktop header.
- Display language and theme controls as text, preserve the theme button label when switching themes and translate its accessible action into French, English, German and Dutch.
- Share header controls and responsive styles between application and landing pages while preserving logout CSRF protection and optional external-link configuration.

**Tests**
- Add rendering regression coverage for translated navigation, active pages, admin access, public headers, logout security, external links, progressive menu markup and landing-page controls.
